user_query: My company is organizing a conference and we need to manage event registrations efficiently. Can you provide us with a registration platform that allows attendees to register online? Additionally, we would like to send automated confirmation emails and collect attendee data for future communication.

TaskList.description: Research and select an online event registration platform that meets the company's needs.
Set up the chosen registration platform, including details of the conference and ticket types.
Integrate an automated email confirmation system within the registration platform.
Create a database to collect and store attendee data for future communications.
Test the registration process to ensure everything is functioning correctly.
